payload.feature:
Decision 0039 (the docs tier inside the run) is proposed and implemented on this branch; bring it to landing quality and ship it. What it holds: brokkr-core's BOOLEAN_INPUTS and brokkr-runtime's ENGINE_OWNED_INPUTS gain fixes_docs_only; the engine records the repository head on phase/entered for the protected phase (contracts/phase-entered-head.v1.schema.json, an additive absent-by-default payload field that fold never reads) and at the protected phase's ruling diffs that head to HEAD with renames unpaired, classifying every path against the repository's .github/delivery-classes.json docs class into the engine-owned fixes_docs_only, absent whenever the question has no honest answer; recipes/fast gains REVIEW-CLEAN-DOCS-FIXES (clean, fixes_applied, fixes_docs_only → ship, flagged) and the five digest witnesses for fast and its derived recipes are re-pinned with the reason; recipe-authoring.md, contracts/README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md's phase-graph label and decision 0039 follow. regex joins brokkr-runtime's dependencies for the class patterns.

Constraints: the exact coverage gate (scripts/coverage-exact.sh) must stay at literal 100%; clippy -D warnings and fmt must stay clean; contracts/ existing files, fixtures/ and policy/phase-machine.json are read-only (the new contracts file is additive); the phase diagram in ARCHITECTURE.md must equal recipes/fast/policy.json's edges; the seat must never be able to claim fixes_docs_only; keep 0039 at Status: proposed and 0037 at proposed; do not name Looper or LaneTally in prose. The decision index must keep every row main carries, in number order.

Reviewer seat on slice-docs-tier-fast (HEAD fe8468d, three commits since main 7994ef0). Verified: cargo fmt --check clean; clippy -D warnings clean; cargo test --workspace --all-features --locked green across all 55 test binaries (diagrams, decisions_index, witness_digests, rename_guard included); the seat's fixes_docs_only claim is dropped at engine.rs:1470 by is_engine_owned before any overlay, and a bundle declaring it fails compile; decision index carries every main row (main lacks 0024 too) in order plus 0039; 0037 and 0039 stay proposed; no Looper/LaneTally in added prose; contracts/ existing files, fixtures/, policy/phase-machine.json untouched. No fixes applied by me (fixes_applied: false) — every finding lives in Engine::fixes_docs_only/docs_class and belongs to one reforge pass with the decision text updated alongside. FINDINGS: (1) SECURITY medium — the docs class is read from the working tree at ruling (docs_class: std::fs::read_to_string(repo/.github/delivery-classes.json)), i.e. from the tree the review seat controls. A review that commits a code change plus a widened class ({"classes":{"docs":{"paths":[""]}}} — the empty pattern matches every path) reads fixes_docs_only: true and ships via REVIEW-CLEAN-DOCS-FIXES without re-verify; the delivery's own absence test demonstrates that an uncommitted working-tree edit to the class file flips the answer. Ruling 3 says 'read as the gate reads it', but the gate (ci.yml CLASSES=base-verifier/.github/delivery-classes.json) deliberately reads the BASE branch's class so the judged delta cannot move its own classifier. This is the rejected alternative ('a seat that can say its own fixes were harmless has been handed the gate') re-entering through the class file. Fix: read the class from the recorded entry head (git show <entered>:.github/delivery-classes.json, or the run's starting head); then a class-file change is itself a path judged by the class it was entered under and .github/*.json matches no docs pattern. Update ruling 3, the schema description, recipe-authoring.md, and move the malformed-class absence tests to committed variants. Context, not mitigation: the decision already concedes REVIEW-CLEAN-NO-FIXES trusts the seat's fixes_applied:false; that older door does not make this one acceptable, since 0039's whole purpose is the engine-owned classification. (2) SECURITY low — the entry head read back from the journal is passed to git unvalidated; the chain is unkeyed (store docs say so), so a tampered journal can place --output=<path> where the schema promises ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ and git diff truncates that file. Guard with the schema pattern before spawning (and/or --end-of-options). (3) CORRECTNESS low — porcelain `git diff` under default core.quotePath quotes non-ASCII paths ("docs/caf\303\251.md"), which then match no docs pattern, so an honest docs-only fix reads false and buys a verify; reader diff.* config also applies. anchor.rs PATCH_DIFF (--literal-pathspecs -c core.quotePath=false diff-tree -r --no-renames) and the gate take the plumbing diff; reuse it (one diff reader, not two — simplicity finding as well). (4) CORRECTNESS low — the entry lookup is find_map over phase/entered picking the latest entry FOR THE PHASE THAT CARRIES A HEAD; if the latest protected-phase entry recorded none, an older visit's head is used and implement's intervening commits join the diff. Fail-closed in practice (a superset all-docs implies the subset is) but not 'the head it was entered at'; use find(latest entry for the phase)?.payload["head"]? and keep branch coverage exact. (5) INFO — regex dialect: engine compiles patterns with the Rust regex crate, the gate joins them with | into jq test() (Oniguruma); today's three patterns are portable, a lookaround or backreference would parse in jq and be refused here (None → verify, fail-closed) — worth one sentence in ruling 3 or the class file's description. (6) INFO — an empty paths array yields Some(false) rather than absent; fail-closed, fine, could be stated.

Reforge pass on slice-docs-tier-fast, commit 9c344ff on top of fe8468d, tree clean. All six reviewer findings addressed in Engine::fixes_docs_only/docs_class with the decision text updated alongside. (1) SECURITY medium: the docs class is now read from git at the recorded entry head (git cat-file blob <entered>:.github/delivery-classes.json), never from the working tree; a widened class file committed by the phase is a `.github/` path judged as code by the class it was entered under. Tests: tree widening ignored (true for prose, false for code), committed widening alone reads false, widening plus code reads false, and the boundary that a widening already judged by verify+review governs a later entry is stated and tested. (2) SECURITY low: the entry head is checked against the schema's ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ shape before any git spawn; an --output=<path> head reads absent and writes no file; uppercase hex is refused. (3) CORRECTNESS low: the diff is anchor::changed_paths (pub(crate)), the PATCH_DIFF plumbing invocation shared with patch_identity — one reader; docs/café.md reads true. (4) CORRECTNESS low: the lookup is the phase's LATEST phase/entered, head taken as recorded; a latest entry without a head reads absent instead of borrowing an older visit's head. (5) regex-dialect sentence in ruling 3 and the docs_class doc comment. (6) empty paths array reads false, stated in ruling 3 and tested. Prose: decision 0039 rulings 2 and 3 rewritten (still Status: proposed; 0037 untouched), contracts/phase-entered-head.v1.schema.json description, docs/guides/recipe-authoring.md engine-owned paragraph. Not touched: contracts/ existing files, fixtures/, policy/phase-machine.json, recipes, ARCHITECTURE.md, decision index. Verified locally: cargo fmt --check clean; clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo test --workspace --all-features --locked green (0 FAILED/panicked markers); coverage via cargo +nightly llvm-cov --branch --lcov counted with the gate's own DA/BRDA/FN dedup logic: 16063/16063 lines, 2438/2438 branches, 1516/1516 functions, no test harness files in the report. scripts/coverage-exact.sh itself could not be invoked from this seat (sandbox refuses the script and env-prefixed forms), so the equality was reproduced from its awk logic in Python and the scratch files removed.
